text: Prosody mein 'metre' se kya tatparya hai?
options: Kavita ke ant mein aane wale rhyme ka naam
Kavita ke stanzas ki sankhya
Kavita ki kul lines ki sankhya
Kavita mein stressed aur unstressed syllables ka vyavasthit rhythmic pattern
ans: Kavita mein stressed aur unstressed syllables ka vyavasthit rhythmic pattern

text: Iambic foot mein kaun sa stress pattern hota hai?
options: Unstressed + Stressed (u /)
Unstressed + Unstressed + Stressed (u u /)
Stressed + Stressed (/ /)
Stressed + Unstressed (/ u)
ans: Unstressed + Stressed (u /)

text: Trochaic foot ka stress pattern kya hota hai?
options: Stressed + Unstressed (/ u)
Unstressed + Stressed (u /)
Unstressed + Unstressed + Stressed (u u /)
Stressed + Stressed (/ /)
ans: Stressed + Unstressed (/ u)

text: Anapaest foot mein syllables ki sankhya aur pattern kya hota hai?
options: 2 syllables — dono stressed (/ /)
3 syllables — ek stressed ke baad do unstressed (/ u u)
3 syllables — do unstressed ke baad ek stressed (u u /)
2 syllables — ek unstressed ke baad ek stressed (u /)
ans: 3 syllables — do unstressed ke baad ek stressed (u u /)

text: Dactyl foot ka pattern kya hota hai?
options: Ek unstressed ke baad ek stressed (u /)
Do stressed syllables (/ /)
Do unstressed ke baad ek stressed (u u /)
Ek stressed ke baad do unstressed (/ u u)
ans: Ek stressed ke baad do unstressed (/ u u)

text: Spondee foot mein kya hota hai?
options: Ek stressed ke baad do unstressed (/ u u)
Do unstressed syllables (u u)
Do stressed syllables (/ /)
Ek unstressed ke baad ek stressed (u /)
ans: Do stressed syllables (/ /)

text: Scansion (scanning) ka mukhya kaam kya hai?
options: Sirf stanza ki lines ko count karna
Kavita ke rhyming words ko alphabetical order mein lagana
Chhand ko feet mein todkar stressed aur unstressed syllables ko mark karna
Kavita ka anuvad (translation) karna
ans: Chhand ko feet mein todkar stressed aur unstressed syllables ko mark karna

text: Iambic pentameter ki ek line mein kitne feet hote hain?
Blank verse ki sahi paribhasha kya hai?
options: Rhymed iambic pentameter
Unrhymed iambic pentameter
Bina kisi niyamit metre wala unrhymed verse
Rhymed trochaic tetrameter
ans: Unrhymed iambic pentameter

text: Nimn mein se kaun sa kaam blank verse mein likha gaya hai?
options: William Shakespeare ki 'Sonnet 18'
Alexander Pope ki 'The Rape of the Lock'
John Milton ki 'Paradise Lost'
Thomas Gray ki 'Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard'
ans: John Milton ki 'Paradise Lost'

text: Heroic couplet ki sahi paribhasha kya hai?
options: Blank verse ki ek lambi line
Iambic pentameter ki do rhyming lines
Trochaic tetrameter ki do lines bina rhyme ke
Chaar lines ka rhyming stanza
ans: Iambic pentameter ki do rhyming lines

text: Heroic couplet ko apne yug mein khaas taur par kis do kavi ne ubhaya?
options: T. S. Eliot aur W. B. Yeats
William Wordsworth aur S. T. Coleridge
John Dryden aur Alexander Pope
John Keats aur P. B. Shelley
ans: John Dryden aur Alexander Pope

text: Perfect rhyme (full rhyme) kis sthiti mein hota hai?
options: Jab do shabdon ke stressed syllables ka vowel aur uske baad ke sabhi sounds milte hain (jaise 'light'–'night')
Jab do lines bilkul rhyme hi na karein
Jab shabd likhne mein ek jaise lagein par uchcharan alag ho
Jab sirf consonant sounds milte hain, vowel nahi
ans: Jab do shabdon ke stressed syllables ka vowel aur uske baad ke sabhi sounds milte hain (jaise 'light'–'night')

text: Eye rhyme kise kehte hain?
options: Jab ek hi shabd line ke ant mein dohraya jaaye
Jab ek hi vowel sound baar-baar aaye
Jab shabd sunne mein rhyme karein par likhne mein nahi
Jab shabd dikhne mein rhyme karte lagte hain par uchcharan mein nahi (jaise 'love'–'prove')
ans: Jab shabd dikhne mein rhyme karte lagte hain par uchcharan mein nahi (jaise 'love'–'prove')

text: Slant rhyme (near rhyme) kya hota hai?
options: Jab ek hi initial consonant baar-baar aaye
Jab lines ek doosre se rhyme hi na karein
Poorn rhyme jisme sabhi sounds milte hain
Aisa adhoora rhyme jisme sounds lagbhag milte hain par poore nahi (jaise 'hill'–'hell')
ans: Aisa adhoora rhyme jisme sounds lagbhag milte hain par poore nahi (jaise 'hill'–'hell')

text: Alliteration kab hota hai?
options: Jab ek hi line mein lagatar shabdon ke shuruaati consonant sounds repeat hon
Jab ek hi vowel sound repeat ho
Jab line ke ant mein shabdon ka rhyme ho
Jab shabd apne darshaye gaye sound ki nakal kare
ans: Jab ek hi line mein lagatar shabdon ke shuruaati consonant sounds repeat hon

text: Assonance kya hai?
options: Vowel sounds ka repetition, khaas taur par stressed syllables mein
Initial consonant sounds ka repetition
Antim consonant sounds ka repetition
Do lines ke ant ka poorn rhyme
ans: Vowel sounds ka repetition, khaas taur par stressed syllables mein

text: Consonance kiski punaravritti se sambandhit hai?
options: Vowel sounds ki punaravritti
Sirf rhyming words ka aana
Sirf shuruaati aksharon ki punaravritti
Consonant sounds ki punaravritti (khaas taur par line ke ant ya beech mein)
ans: Consonant sounds ki punaravritti (khaas taur par line ke ant ya beech mein)

text: Onomatopoeia kya hai?
options: Atishayokti (exaggeration)
Kisi anupasthit vyakti ko sambodhan karna
Aisa shabd jo apne darshaye gaye sound ki nakal kare (jaise 'buzz', 'hiss')
Do viparit shabdon ka saath-saath aana
ans: Aisa shabd jo apne darshaye gaye sound ki nakal kare (jaise 'buzz', 'hiss')

text: Enjambment kya hai?
options: Jab do lines aapas mein rhyme karein
Jab ek line ka arth ya vakya ruke bina agli line mein chal jaye
Jab line ke madhya mein ek pause aaye
Jab ek line ko baar-baar dohraya jaaye
ans: Jab ek line ka arth ya vakya ruke bina agli line mein chal jaye

text: Caesura kya hota hai?
options: Do lines ke beech ka rhyme
Kavita ke ant mein aane wala refrain
Ek line ke beech mein aane wala pause
Ek khaas kism ka foot
ans: Ek line ke beech mein aane wala pause

text: Refrain kise kehte hain?
options: Kavita mein baar-baar dohraye jaane wala shabd, phrase ya line
Line ke shuru mein aane wala pause
Do rhyming lines ka joda
Iambic hexameter ki ek lambi line
ans: Kavita mein baar-baar dohraye jaane wala shabd, phrase ya line

text: Shakespearean (English) sonnet ka rhyme scheme kya hai?
options: abab cdcd efef gg
abba abba cde cde
aabb ccdd eeff gg
abab abab cdcd cd
ans: abab cdcd efef gg

text: Petrarchan (Italian) sonnet ke octave ka rhyme scheme kya hai?
options: abba abba
abab abab
abba baab
aabb aabb
ans: abba abba

text: Prosody mein 'couplet' aur 'quatrain' mein mukhya antar kya hai?
options: Dono mein hi 3 lines hoti hain
Couplet mein 2 lines aur quatrain mein 4 lines hoti hain
Couplet mein 4 lines aur quatrain mein 2 lines hoti hain
Couplet blank verse hai aur quatrain rhymed
ans: Couplet mein 2 lines aur quatrain mein 4 lines hoti hain

text: Terza rima ka rhyme scheme kya hai?
options: abba abba ...
aba bcb cdc ...
abab abab ...
aabb ccdd ...
ans: aba bcb cdc ...

text: Ottava rima ka rhyme scheme kya hai?
options: abbaabba
ababbcbcc
aabba
abababcc
ans: abababcc

text: Spenserian stanza ki visheshta kya hai?
options: 14 lines iambic pentameter, rhyme scheme abab cdcd efef gg
9 lines — pehli 8 iambic pentameter aur ant mein ek alexandrine; rhyme scheme ababbcbcc
8 lines, sab iambic tetrameter, rhyme scheme abababcc
6 lines, rhyme scheme ababab
ans: 9 lines — pehli 8 iambic pentameter aur ant mein ek alexandrine; rhyme scheme ababbcbcc

text: Simile kis par adharit hota hai?
options: Do cheezon ki tulna 'like' ya 'as' ka prayog karke
Bina 'like'/'as' ke seedhi tulna
Atishayokti (exaggeration)
Nirjiv ko sajiv banana
ans: Do cheezon ki tulna 'like' ya 'as' ka prayog karke

text: Metaphor kis prakar ka alankar hai?
options: Ek cheez ko doosri ke barabar batana bina 'like'/'as' ke (implicit comparison)
Tulna 'like' ya 'as' ke saath karna
Sound ki nakal karna
Do viparit shabdon ka saath-saath aana
ans: Ek cheez ko doosri ke barabar batana bina 'like'/'as' ke (implicit comparison)

text: Personification kya hai?
options: Kisi anupasthit vyakti ko sambodhan karna
Nirjiv cheezon ya bhaavnon ko manushya jaisi shaktiyan ya vyavhaar dena
Part ko whole ke liye prayog karna
Atishayokti
ans: Nirjiv cheezon ya bhaavnon ko manushya jaisi shaktiyan ya vyavhaar dena

text: Hyperbole kya hai?
options: Badha-chadha kar ke kahi gayi atishayokti (exaggeration)
Nirjiv ko sajiv banana
Kam kar ke kahi gayi baat
Do viparit shabdon ka saath
ans: Badha-chadha kar ke kahi gayi atishayokti (exaggeration)

text: Oxymoron kya hai?
options: Tulna 'as' ke saath karna
Part ko whole ke liye prayog karna
Ek hi baat ko do baar kehna
Do viparit ya viruddh shabdon ko saath rakhna (jaise 'living death')
ans: Do viparit ya viruddh shabdon ko saath rakhna (jaise 'living death')

text: Synecdoche kya hai?
options: Do viparit shabdon ka saath-saath aana
Kisi judi hui cheez ka naam us cheez ke liye prayog karna
Part ko whole ke liye ya whole ko part ke liye prayog karna (jaise 'wheels' = car)
Sound ki nakal karna
ans: Part ko whole ke liye ya whole ko part ke liye prayog karna (jaise 'wheels' = car)

text: Metonymy kya hai?
options: Nirjiv ko sajiv banana
Part ko whole ke liye prayog karna
Kisi cheez ke liye usse juda hua naam prayog karna (jaise 'crown' = king/royalty)
Atishayokti
ans: Kisi cheez ke liye usse juda hua naam prayog karna (jaise 'crown' = king/royalty)

text: Euphemism kya hai?
options: Do viparit shabdon ka saath-saath aana
Kisi kadwi ya ashubh baat ko komal shabdon mein kehna (jaise 'passed away' for 'died')
Kadwi baat ko aur kadhwa kar kehna
Kisi anupasthit vyakti ko sambodhan karna
ans: Kisi kadwi ya ashubh baat ko komal shabdon mein kehna (jaise 'passed away' for 'died')

text: Apostrophe kya hai?
options: Kisi anupasthit vyakti, mrit vyakti ya nirjiv cheez ko sambodhit karna
Part ko whole ke liye prayog karna
Line ke beech mein aane wala pause
Do lines ke ant ka rhyme
ans: Kisi anupasthit vyakti, mrit vyakti ya nirjiv cheez ko sambodhit karna

text: Antithesis kya hai?
options: Sound ki nakal karna
Ek hi vaakya mein do viparit vichaaron ko saath-saath rakhna (jaise 'To err is human, to forgive divine')
Nirjiv ko sajiv banana
Atishayokti (exaggeration)
ans: Ek hi vaakya mein do viparit vichaaron ko saath-saath rakhna (jaise 'To err is human, to forgive divine')

text: Transferred epithet kya hai?
options: Do viparit shabdon ka saath-saath aana
Part ko whole ke liye prayog karna
Tulna 'like' ke saath karna
Visheshan ko us cheez se hata kar usse judi doosri cheez par lagana (jaise 'a sleepless night')
ans: Visheshan ko us cheez se hata kar usse judi doosri cheez par lagana (jaise 'a sleepless night')

text: Pun kya hai?
options: Sound ki nakal karna
Kisi anupasthit vyakti ko sambodhan karna
Atishayokti
Ek shabd ko uske do arthon mein mazaaq ya matlab ke liye prayog karna
ans: Ek shabd ko uske do arthon mein mazaaq ya matlab ke liye prayog karna
